parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the domain name group. If you do not specify this parameter, all groups are queried.

parameters.name: KeyWord
parameters.description: The keyword for the query. A case-insensitive \`contains\` search is performed.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response.

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

The default value is **zh**.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start date. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of content to query.

- domain: domain name

- slavedns: secondary DNS

If you do not specify this parameter, all types are queried.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end date. The format is **YYYY-MM-DD**.
